quiz.question: The Government of Maharashtra recently signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) worth ₹1.14 lakh crore with AM Intelligence Labs to set up which of the following facilities in the Mumbai region?
options: Integrated Green Data Centre Park and an AI Compute Hub
Advanced Semiconductor Fab and Chip Assembly Facility
Electric Vehicle Gigafactory and Battery Recycling Hub
quiz.explanation: In May 2026, the Government of Maharashtra signed a ₹1.14 lakh crore MoU with AM Intelligence Labs to set up an Integrated Green Data Centre Park and an AI Compute Hub in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The project will have a planned capacity of 500 MW powered by renewable energy and is expected to create 8,000 high-tech jobs.

quiz.question: In July 2026, the Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation (MIDC) signed a ₹3,000 crore concession agreement with Ramky Infrastructure's subsidiary to develop a High-Tech Pharmaceutical Park in which district of Maharashtra?
quiz.explanation: MIDC executed a concession agreement with Maha Integrated Life Sciences City Limited (MILeS City), a subsidiary of Ramky Infrastructure Ltd, to develop a ₹3,000 crore High-Tech Pharmaceutical Park. Spanning 1,000 hectares across Mangaon and Roha talukas in Raigad district, the park is situated within the Dighi Port Industrial Area under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.

quiz.question: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) in July 2026 flagged financial irregularities in Maharashtra's flagship 'Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana' for FY 2024-25. According to the CAG, how much unauthorized excess expenditure was recorded above the allocated budget?
quiz.explanation: The CAG revealed that Maharashtra's Department of Women and Child Development recorded a budgetary breach in the Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana, spending ₹33,237.24 crore against an allocation of ₹29,693.09 crore. This resulted in an unexplained, unauthorized excess expenditure of ₹3,541.16 crore. The CAG also flagged the reappropriation of ₹3,490.75 crore from the 'Lek Ladki Yojana' to fund this scheme.

quiz.question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to flag off India's first-ever hydrogen-powered passenger train from which railway station?
quiz.explanation: India's first hydrogen-powered passenger train is set to be flagged off by Prime Minister Narendra Modi from Jind railway station in Haryana. This project marks a significant green transition in Indian Railways, using hydrogen fuel cells to generate clean electricity instead of diesel.

quiz.question: In July 2026, NASA astronaut Anil Menon lifted off for his first 8-month long-duration mission to the International Space Station (ISS) aboard which spacecraft?
quiz.explanation: Indian-origin NASA astronaut Anil Menon lifted off on July 14, 2026, aboard the Russian Soyuz MS-29 spacecraft from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan. He was accompanied by Roscosmos cosmonauts Pyotr Dubrov and Anna Kikina for an 8-month mission on the ISS as part of Expeditions 74 and 75.

quiz.question: The Union Government has listed the 'Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026' for introduction in the Lok Sabha. What key provision does this amendment seek to introduce?
options: Mandating national anthem playback before every assembly election voting
Making any intentional insult or obstruction to the singing of the National Song 'Vande Mataram' a punishable offence
Imposing a complete ban on commercial use of the Indian National Flag
Prescribing strict dress codes for public events where national symbols are displayed
quiz.explanation: The Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026, has been listed for the Monsoon session of Parliament. The amendment seeks to make any intentional insult or obstruction to the singing of the National Song 'Vande Mataram' a punishable offence, providing it with statutory protection similar to the National Anthem.

quiz.question: NITI Aayog recently released the 'Roadmap for Building India as a Leading BioEconomy Powerhouse by 2035'. What is the total outlay of the proposed BioEconomy Growth Fund for the 2026-2035 period?
quiz.explanation: NITI Aayog's Bioeconomy Roadmap 2035 proposes a ₹50,000 crore BioEconomy Growth Fund for the 2026-2035 period. The fund aims to bridge the gap between proof-of-concept research and commercial manufacturing in biomanufacturing, advanced therapeutics, synthetic biology, and diagnostics.

quiz.question: In July 2026, the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) and the Ministry of Power released the draft Corporate Average Fuel Efficiency III (CAFE III) norms. To which category of vehicles do these proposed norms apply?
options: Heavy commercial trucks and cargo vehicles (Category N3)
M1 category passenger vehicles (weighing up to 3,500 kg)
quiz.explanation: The draft CAFE III norms released by the Ministry of Power apply to M1 category passenger vehicles (manufactured or imported for sale in India) weighing up to 3,500 kg. The proposed norms are set to apply from FY2027-28 to FY2031-32, evaluating automaker fleet compliance over three-year blocks.

quiz.question: During school education petitions in the Supreme Court in July 2026, which age/class range did Supreme Court Judge Justice B.V. Nagarathna recommend for introducing and stopping the third language under the three-language policy?
options: Start in Class 1 and stop in Class 5
Start in Class 5 and stop in Class 8
Start in Class 6 and stop in Class 9
Start in Class 6 and stop in Class 10
quiz.explanation: Supreme Court Judge Justice B.V. Nagarathna made an oral appeal in court to avoid introducing a third language in Class 9 to reduce stress on students facing Board exams. She recommended that the third language should instead be introduced in Class 6 and stopped in Class 9.

quiz.question: In July 2026, India's first high-precision, Ethernet-based time distribution facility using CERN-developed 'White Rabbit' technology was inaugurated at which location?
quiz.explanation: Union Minister inaugurated the White Rabbit Technology-based Indian Standard Time (IST) Distribution Demonstration Network at the Regional Reference Standards Laboratory (RRSL) in Jakkur, Bengaluru. Led by the Legal Metrology Division, the facility uses CERN's open-source White Rabbit synchronization protocol to transmit IST over wide-area networks with sub-nanosecond precision.
